title: Coronary angiography, second set: find the narrowing, with and without one
description: More invasive coronary angiograms (single contrast-filled frames, 512 x 512 px), one case per image, left and right coronary systems, taken from videos not used in the first set. Most frames carry a box drawn by cardiologists around a narrowing of 50% or more, with the degree of narrowing as a category, with more very tight (99% and total occlusion) examples; some frames show only milder irregularities and some come from runs with no lesion at all. The boxes are rectangles around the narrowing, not outlines. No pixel size or projection angle is distributed.
